Sprinting for ? seconds with full Class Ability Energy grants a 50 HP frontal overshield. Shield grants x1 <arc/> Bolt Charge per hit absorbed.

While <arc/>Amplified, the shield gains an additional 33% damage resistance, effectively increasing to 67 HP.

This overshield grants <pve 60% /> <pvp [10%] /> Splash Damage Resistance, and an additional <pve 10% /> Damage Resistance against combatants. 

Upon being destroyed, Overshield consumes your Class Ability Energy. Overshield will fully absorb any overkill damage on the last hit.

Juggernaut Overshield stacks with other Overshields.
